reading.body:
Element Critical CH2 in Wood Dale, Illinois has 7 MW of published IT capacity across 151,000 square feet of technical space, enough to support roughly 175 high-density AI training racks or 700 standard colocation racks depending on power distribution the operator has not disclosed.

The facility holds three compliance certifications: PCI DSS for payment processing, HIPAA for health data, and ISO 27001 for information security management. These certifications qualify the site for regulated workloads but say nothing about AI infrastructure requirements such as high-density power rails or low-latency interconnect topology. Element Critical publishes no technical claims on those dimensions.

Among 44 Illinois data center facilities tracked here, only 6 report megawatt capacity. Those six combined total 236 MW, making CH2 the fifth largest by that measure at roughly 3 percent of the state's published capacity. The operator does not state whether 7 MW represents the site's full buildout or only the portion currently disclosed, leaving the actual scaling headroom unknown.
